@@ -18,8 +18,12 @@ priv_mode: M
 length: MXLEN
 description: PMP entry address
 definedBy:
-  extension:
-    name: Smpmp
+  allOf:
+    - extension:
+        name: Sm
+    - param:
+        name: NUM_PMP_ENTRIES
+        greaterThan: <%= pmpaddr_num %>
body:
NUM_PMP_ENTRIES is tricky. It can be any number between 0-64, but the spec states that exactly 0, 16, or 64 pmpaddr registers are implemented. When NUM_PMP_ENTRIES is not 0, 16, or 64, then registers > NUM_PMP_ENTRIES but less than the number of extant registers are read-only-zero.

To reflect that, the definition needs to be:

```
   - param:
       name: NUM_PMP_ENTRIES
       <%= pmpaddr_num < 16 ? "greaterThan: 0" : "greaterThan: 16" %>
```
